name: GNAPHALIUM POLYCEPHALUM
key_symptoms: Cramps in calves of legs and feet when in bed. Rheumatic pain in ankle joints and legs. Intense pain along the sciatic nerve; numbness alternates with pain. Frequent pains in calves and feet. Gouty pains in big toes. Better, drawing limbs up, flexing thigh on abdomen. Gouty concretions (Ammon benz). Anterior crural neuralgia (Staph). Pain in joints as if they lacked oil. Chronic muscular rheumatism of back and neck.
Chronic backache in lumbar region; better resting on back. Lumbago with numbness in lower part of back and weight in pelvis.

head_symptoms: Intermittent pains of superior maxillary of both sides.
gi_symptoms: Borborygmus. Colic; pain in various parts of the abdomen. Irritated prostate. First stage of cholera infantum; vomiting and purging.
urinary_symptoms: Weight and fullness in pelvis. Dysmenorrhśa, with scanty and painful menses.
